name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
thesis: Management denies a Rs 400 crore siphoning report and says NHB red-flagged the account with no reasons given; disbursements slowed, credit rating under watch, and no audit findings disclosed on a Rs 1,100 crore book.

triggers.label: NHB red flag on account, reasons undisclosed
triggers.q: The NHB does not declare a fraud in the Red Flag account.

triggers.label: Fresh sanctions and disbursements slowed
triggers.q: We have now slowed our fresh sanctions and disbursement for some time.

triggers.label: Liquidity figures withheld on repeated asks
triggers.q: No, I cannot tell you the amount or figure.

triggers.label: Rating under watch, not downgraded
triggers.q: Acuite has confirmed our rating by keeping it under watch.

triggers.label: Conversion to NBFC: 6+ months process
triggers.q: It takes at least 6 months to process.

flags: NHB red flag on account; Rs 400 cr siphoning allegation
4 analyst questions deflected (Liquidity / collection amounts, Nature of NHB observations)
about: Housing finance company lending mainly to individuals for home purchase, construction and related housing needs; the board has proposed converting to an NBFC licence.

in.why: Management guided to a Q2 FY27 slowdown from paused fresh sanctions and disbursements, with Q3 and Q4 "good" and no quantified revenue guidance; growth is asserted, not backed by specific orders or capacity, and the NHB red flag is pending.

vetoWhy: NHB red flag on account; Rs 400 cr siphoning allegation
Heavy evasion with very negative tone
